notes:
Shorthand notes from AE/SE: - Mid-market B2B SaaS, strong PLG motion; product teams own infra decisions. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first to validate embeddings + semantic search; now leaning toward Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- Primary workload: nightly batch ingest ~2M small docs/month (PDFs, release notes, support tickets) + realtime search traffic ~40-60 QPS across EU+NA. Need vectorization pipeline to handle 200k-300k embeddings/day during peak reindex windows.
- Targets: p50 search latency <150ms, p95 <350ms for top-k retrieval (k=10) after vector DB lookup; embedding generation batch throughput target >=10k/sec for offline jobs (parallelized).
- Vector DB: currently evaluating managed Pinecone & Weaviate; prefer Redwood-native routing to managed vectors or guidance for Weaviate+Redwood setup. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization & batching.
- Security: must have SSO (SAML), SOC2 report, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for at least subset of customer data. Legal flagged data residency before procurement.
- Quote from Head of Platform: "Need predictable unit cost + ability to burst for reindex windows — can't have 3x cost spikes."
- POC ask: SE to run end-to-end throughput test (hosted/dedicated compare) with their sample corpus; provide 95th pct latency report and cost estimate for steady-state + reindex window.
- Next practical blockers: finance approval for baseline committed capacity; legal to close residency language; confirm vector DB architecture for retrieval latency.
- Artifacts: pricing deck (linked), POC throughput plan (linked), security FAQ draft in Drive.
